# ces-revisions roadmap

## Outcomes

Source: your partner's words, 2026-11-10. Background: specs/ces-revisions-prompt.md, specs/ces-revisions-research-chatgpt.md, specs/ces-revisions-research-claude.md, specs/ces-revisions-research-gemini.md.
Choices made: Python 3.14 (.python-version), managed with uv; pytest and ruff for dev.

| # | Outcome | Track | Rank | Cost (estimate; basis) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| O1 | How the size of the one-month revision moves with the number of collection days before first release | A | 1 | Release calendar and monthly vintages: a day or two to assemble; fit time on ~40 years of monthly vintages measured by Stage 1 |
| O2 | How the size of the two-month revision moves with the first-closing collection rate | A | 3 | Collection rates from archived releases; fit time measured by Stage 1 |
| O3 | How much of the one- and two-month revisions comes from late sample reports, and how much from seasonal-factor revision | A | 2 | Needs NSA and SA vintages side by side; cost unknown until Stage 1 has run |
| O4 | How revision size moves with real BLS appropriations, continuing resolutions and shutdowns | B | 2 | Budget series: several days to hand-build from budget justifications |
| O5 | How revision size moves with BLS staffing counts | B | 3 | Staffing series: several days to hand-build from budget justifications and FedScope |
| O6 | How revision size moves with CES sample size and sample attrition | B | 1 | Hand-built from archived releases; measured by Stage 2 |

Tracks: A — Collection interval and revision size (research). B — Budget, staffing and attrition (research). Split because Track A rests on sharp month-to-month calendar variation that public release dates give directly, while Track B's covariates move slowly, trend together, must be hand-built, and its answer does not change Track A's model. Track ranking: A, then B.

## Stages

- [ ] Stage 1: Collection days and one-month revision size
      Objective: Measure, on real CES vintages, how the size of the one-month revision moves with collection days before first release.
      Outcomes: O1
      Track: A
      Consumes: nothing (package is a scaffold)
      Produces: a real-data panel of first and second prints with release dates and collection days; specs/ces-revisions-stage-1-findings.md
      Exit: O1 — an estimate, with uncertainty, of how one-month revision size moves with collection days, from real vintages; the findings file records the measured time to assemble the vintages and the measured time of the real fit.
      Leaves out: vintage provenance manifest: suggested, see the approval question; full validation suite: suggested, see the approval question
      ROUTING: brainstorming

- [ ] Stage 2: Sample size, attrition and revision size
      Objective: Measure, on real data, how revision size moves with CES sample size and sample attrition.
      Outcomes: O6
      Track: B
      Consumes: Stage 1's vintage panel (revision sizes)
      Produces: a hand-built monthly series of CES sample size and attrition; specs/ces-revisions-stage-2-findings.md
      Exit: O6 — an estimate, with uncertainty, of how revision size moves with sample size and attrition, from real data; the findings file records the measured time to hand-build the series and the measured time of the real fit.
      Leaves out: vintage provenance manifest: suggested, see the approval question; full validation suite: suggested, see the approval question
      ROUTING: brainstorming
